---
title: "Example data simulation"
format: html
editor: visual
---

### Set up study design: two groups with pre and post-measurements

```{r}
set.seed(8675309)
library(faux)

between <- list(group = c(int = "intervention", con = "control"))

within <- list(time = c("pre", "y"))

mu <- data.frame(
  con = c(5, 5), 
  int = c(5, 6), 
  row.names = within$time
  )
```

### Simulate data

```{r}
df_design <- sim_design(
  within, 
  between, 
  n = 100, 
  mu = mu, 
  sd = 3, 
  r = .7, 
  empirical = FALSE, 
  plot = FALSE
  )
```

### Save simulated dataset

```{r}
write.csv(df_design, "simulated_data_analysis.csv")
```
